name: Check recorded production runs
description: prove(spec, subject, { traces }) also checks recorded real input/output pairs. A trace that breaks a clause makes it violated with empirical evidence and the violating trace (and its reference) in the result; if the clause was proved on the model, the note says a trusted piece does not hold. With traces but no subject, a clause that holds on every applicable trace is evidenced, with the rule-of-three bound.
